name: Coire Brecain

attributes.attribute: the Irish name of the Corrievreckan whirlpool

text: Coire Brecain is the Irish name-form of the great whirlpool, Corrievreckan, between Jura and Scarba off the west Scottish coast (the name means the caldron of Breccan). MacKillop treats Coire Brecain as a cross-reference to his entry on Corrievreckan. No separate article covers the whirlpool under this Irish form. Readers seeking the legend of the drowned hero should follow that pointer. See Corrievreckan.

okr.objective: Coire Brecain is the Irish name behind the Corrievreckan whirlpool.
key_results: Coire Brecain is the Irish form of the whirlpool name Corrievreckan.
MacKillop treats the headword as a cross-reference to Corrievreckan.
